assets.title: Step by Step
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: In this step-by-step tutorial series, you will create your first complete 2D game while learning the core concepts of Xogot and the Godot game engine. Start by learning about Nodes and Scenes, the building blocks of all Godot games.

assets.title: Your First 2D Game
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Create your first complete 2D game from scratch! This tutorial walks you through building a simple game where your character must move and avoid enemies. You'll learn scene setup, player movement, enemy spawning, and score tracking.

assets.title: TileSets and TileMaps
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Get you up and running with the Xogot TileMap workflow. By the end, you will be able to create with Tiles and get started on your dream 2D game, on the go!

assets.title: Xogot for Godot Users: Getting Oriented on iPad & iPhone
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: If you already know Godot, this video will help you get comfortable working in Xogot, the native version of Godot for iPad and iPhone. Rather than teaching Godot, this video walks you through where tools have moved, why the interface looks different, and how Xogot adapts Godot's workflow for a touch-first environment.

assets.title: Build Smooth & Customizable Platformer Movement in Xogot
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Learn how to create precise, responsive platformer movement entirely in Xogot. This in-depth tutorial walks through everything you need to know to design smooth and customizable 2D platformer controls — from basic movement to advanced physics and jump mechanics including Coyote Time, Jump Buffering, and Variable Jump Height.

assets.title: Build Smooth Top-Down Player Movement in Xogot
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Learn how to create smooth top-down player movement entirely in Xogot. This step-by-step tutorial shows how to build a responsive top-down player controller in under 15 lines of code using CharacterBody2D with sprites, collisions, and fluid movement using linear interpolation.

assets.title: Build Tap-to-Move & Directional Sprites in Xogot
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Learn how to build tap-to-move player controls and directional sprite animations entirely in Xogot. This tutorial walks through setting up a clean and responsive point-and-click movement system using CharacterBody2D, Sprite2D, and directional animation frames.

assets.title: Introduction to WorldEnvironment in Xogot
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Welcome to Xogot's Modular 3D Game Development Series! Learn how the WorldEnvironment node shapes the look and feel of your 3D scenes. You'll learn to add a WorldEnvironment, adjust properties for visual feedback, choose Background Modes, and explore Panorama, Procedural, and Physical Sky options.

assets.title: Introduction to Lighting in Xogot
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Explore the core 3D light nodes in Xogot. Learn how DirectionalLight3D, OmniLight3D, and SpotLight3D work, when to use each one, and which settings matter most when lighting your 3D scenes. Covers directional lighting, omni lights, spot lights, light energy, indirect lighting, and shadow behavior.

assets.title: Introduction to Cameras in Xogot
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Learn how to add and configure a Camera3D, how to preview your game through the camera, and which camera settings matter most when building 3D scenes. We also cover best practices like using a Marker3D as a camera pivot, parenting the camera to a player, and understanding how different projection modes affect the look and feel of your game.

assets.title: Introduction to Placeholder Models in Xogot
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Learn how to create temporary geometry directly in Xogot using MeshInstance3D and CSG (Constructive Solid Geometry) nodes, and when to use each approach. We cover common placeholder shapes, materials, visibility layers, and how to combine or modify geometry to quickly block out levels and gameplay.

assets.title: Build a Feature-Rich 2D Camera System in Xogot
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Learn how to build a dynamic and feature-rich 2D camera system entirely in Xogot. This tutorial walks through creating a flexible Camera2D setup with camera targets, room-based behavior, camera limits, and screen shake. The system supports smoothly switching focus between the player, rooms, and secondary targets, all while running fully on iPad.

assets.title: Quick Polygon Environments for Testing in Xogot
assets.author: Xogot
assets.description: Build quick, flexible environments for testing and prototyping using polygon collisions in Xogot - the iPad and iPhone version of the Godot Engine. This short tutorial shows how to use CollisionPolygon2D and Polygon2D together to rapidly block out test levels and environments. This approach is ideal for early prototyping, iteration, and gameplay testing directly on iPad.

This is a simple game where your character must move and avoid the enemies for as long as possible.

This is a finished version of the game featured in the "Your first 2D game" tutorial in the documentation. For more details,
consider following the tutorial in the documentation: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/getting_started/first_2d_game/index.html

Language: GDScript

Renderer: Compatibility
assets.title: Save the Axolotl

assets.description:
Kenney's Starter Kit 3D Platformer is a basic template for a 3D platformer game in Godot 4.3 (stable). Includes features like;

- Character controller (with double jump)
- Collectable coins and falling platforms
- Camera controls (rotate, zoom)
- Gamepad support
- Sprites and 3D Models (CC0 licensed)
- Sound effects (CC0 licensed)
assets.title: Starter Kit 3D Platformer

assets.description:
Starter Kit FPS is a basic template for a 3D first person shooter in Godot 4.3 (stable). Includes features like;

- Character controller
- Weapons, switching weapons
- Enemies
- Sprites and 3D Models (CC0 licensed)

Controls:

- W A S D: Movement
- Spacebar: Jump
- Left mouse button: Shoot
- E: Switch weapon
assets.title: Starter Kit FPS

assets.description: This open-source Godot 4 demo shows how to create a 3D character controller inspired by games like Ratchet and Clank or Jak and Daxter. You can copy the character to your project as a plug-and-play asset to prototype 3D games with and build upon. It features a character that can run, jump, make a melee attack, aim, shoot, and throw grenades.
assets.title: RoboBlast

assets.description:
This starter kit includes all the essential mechanics for your 2d platformer game. Using this kit, you will be able to make your own 2d platformer in no time.

This kit includes:
- Juicy Platformer Controller
- Animated Player
- 2 Demo Levels
- Level Management
- Score System
- Sound Effects

The code is documented for better understanding and each script and function is documented with its purpose. The code is also beginner friendly, who wants to learn by diving directly into the coding game!
assets.title: 2D Platformer - Starter Kit

assets.description:
This demo is a pixel art 2D platformer with graphics and sound.
It shows you how to code characters and physics-based objects in a real game context. This is a relatively complete demo where the player can jump, walk on slopes, fire bullets, interact with enemies, and more. It contains one closed level, and the player is invincible, unlike the enemies.
You will find most of the demo’s content in the `level.tscn` scene. You can open it from the default `game.tscn` scene, or double click on `level.tscn` in the `src/level/` directory.
We invite you to open the demo's GDScript files in the editor as they contain a lot of comments that explain how each class works.
assets.title: 2D Platformer Demo

assets.description:
Very simple template to use as a starting point for a top-down action RPG. 

It works with keyboard, touch and gamepad input, and has a character with a few moves, an inventory system and a quest system.

I created this for my students as a template for their final exam so everything is implemented in the simplest form possible. Take it as a starting point rather than a solid foundation. 

Live demo: https://redmagegames.com/elcaballerohueco/
assets.title: Top-down Action RPG Template

assets.description:
This is a 2D, Pixelart, Topdown, action Starter/Template Project that includes all the basics you need to get started creating a game.

It includes:
- 2 Levels with different tile-sets
- Quests
- Combat
- Talking NPC's
- Coins to pick up
..And much more!

Consider clicking 'View Files' rather than 'Download' to see the full project on GitHub. There might be a newer version there and you can find more information, links to helpful resources, video tutorials for different parts of the project etc.
assets.title: Topdown Pixelart Starter Project

assets.description: Work-in-progress of a twin-stick shooter starter kit for Godot 4 using the FREE Kaykit Prototype Bits as a base for the 3D Assets.
assets.title: Twin-Stick Shooter

assets.description: Pocket Godot is a template for mobile game development using Godot
assets.title: Pocket Godot

assets.description:
Third person shooter (TPS) demo made using Godot Engine.

Controls:

- Mouse or Gamepad Right Stick: Look around
- W/A/S/D, Arrow keys, Gamepad Left Analog Stick or Gamepad D-Pad: Move
- Space, Gamepad A/Cross: Jump
- Right Mouse Button, Gamepad Left Trigger (L2) (press to toggle, or hold and release): Aim
- Left Mouse Button, Gamepad Right Trigger (R2): Shoot (only while aiming)
- Escape, Gamepad Start: Go to main menu/quit
- F11 or Alt + Enter: Toggle fullscreen
- F3: Toggle debugging information (such as FPS counter)
assets.title: Third Person Shooter (TPS) Demo
